Expected output SHAPE for s08 (context-window management).

The demo is fully OFFLINE and deterministic — it fabricates a fixed conversation
and runs the ContextManager over it, so this output IS reproducible byte-for-byte
(no LLM, no temp paths).

------------------------------------------------------------------------------
$ GOWORK=off go run .
------------------------------------------------------------------------------
[s08] budget=3000 keepRecent=4 turns=12
  before: messages=25  est_tokens=13443  over_budget=true
  roles:  u a u a u a u a u a u a u a u a u a u a u a u a u
  drop range: [2..19] (18 messages, even=true, last-removed role="assistant")
  after:  messages=7  est_tokens=2328  over_budget=false
  roles:  u a u a u a u
  truncated=true
  invariants: first_task_msg_kept=true recent_tail_kept=true no_orphan_tool_result=true

What to verify you ran it correctly:
  1. before.over_budget=true     (the 25-message history overflows the budget)
  2. drop range starts at 2       (the first user/assistant PAIR is never removed)
  3. last-removed role="assistant"(kept tail resumes on a user message → valid order)
  4. after.messages < before      (a middle range was dropped)
  5. after.over_budget=false      (one truncation pass brought it under budget)
  6. all three invariants=true    (first task msg kept, recent tail kept, no orphan
                                   tool_result left dangling at the new boundary)

Flags that change the shape:
  go run . -budget 100000   # huge budget → over_budget=false, truncated=false (no-op)
  go run . -budget 1500     # tight budget → after still over_budget (one pass isn't
                            #   enough; cline truncates again on the NEXT request)
  go run . -keep 8          # preserve more recent turns (kept tail is longer)
  go run . -turns 30        # a longer conversation to drop from

Tests are fully offline and need no flags:

------------------------------------------------------------------------------
$ GOWORK=off go test -count=1 ./...
------------------------------------------------------------------------------
ok  	learn-cline/s08	0.30s
